test_title: PYST 31: SSC CHSL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Reena and Riya together can complete a piece of work in 36 days. Riya and Geeta together can complete it in 54 days. Reena and Geeta together can complete it in 81 days. In how many days can Reena alone complete the work?
solution:
**Given:**

Reena and Riya together can complete a piece of work in 36 days.

Riya and Geeta together can complete it in 54 days

Reena and Geeta together can complete it in 81 days

**Calculation:**

Reena and Riya = 36 

Riya and Geeta = 54

Reena and Geeta = 81

Total Work LCM (36, 54, 81) = 324

Efficiency of Reena and Riya = 9

Efficiency of Riya and Geeta = 6

Efficiency of Reena and Geeta = 4

Efficiency of Reena + Riya + Geeta = 19/2

Efficiency of Reena = 19/2 - 6

⇒ 7/2

According to the question,

⇒ 324/(7/2)

⇒ 648/7

**∴ Reena alone complete the work in 92 (4)/(7)** **days.**
